Precondition: Toolshop homepage is open and the catalog has loaded.
Test Data: Distinctive name of a product currently displayed in the catalog.
Test Steps: 1. Record the selected product name; 2. Enter the name in the Search field; 3. Submit or wait for the search to run; 4. Review the results; 5. Clear the search.
Expected Result: The selected product is displayed; unrelated products are excluded; clearing the search restores the catalog.

Precondition: Toolshop homepage is open and the catalog has loaded.
Test Data: Unique nonexistent search term generated at execution time.
Test Steps: 1. Enter the nonexistent term in the Search field; 2. Submit or wait for the search to run; 3. Review the result area; 4. Clear the search.
Expected Result: No products are returned; a clear empty-result state is displayed; no error or broken layout occurs; clearing restores the catalog.

Precondition: Toolshop homepage is open; filters and catalog are loaded.
Test Data: A currently available category containing at least one product.
Test Steps: 1. Note the initial catalog state; 2. Select the category filter; 3. Review every displayed product; 4. Clear the category filter.
Expected Result: All displayed products belong to the selected category; nonmatching products are excluded; clearing the filter restores the unfiltered catalog.

Precondition: Toolshop catalog is loaded and contains an in-stock product.
Test Data: One dynamically selected in-stock product; record its catalog name and price.
Test Steps: 1. Record the product name and price; 2. Open the product; 3. Review its details; 4. Compare the detail values with the catalog values.
Expected Result: The correct product page opens; name and price match the catalog; description, image, brand, category, stock state, and available sustainability information are displayed.

Test Scenario: Add an in-stock product to cart
Precondition: Cart is empty and the catalog contains an in-stock product.
Test Data: One dynamically selected in-stock product with its displayed name and unit price.
Test Steps: 1. Open the product details; 2. Add the product to the cart; 3. Open the cart; 4. Compare the cart information with the selected product.
Expected Result: The cart contains the selected product once with the correct name, unit price, initial quantity, subtotal, and cart item count.

Test Scenario: Update quantity and remove a cart item
Precondition: Start with an empty cart; an in-stock product is available.
Test Data: One dynamically selected in-stock product; updated quantity of 2.
Test Steps: 1. Add the product to the cart; 2. Open the cart; 3. Change its quantity to 2; 4. Verify the quantity and totals; 5. Remove the product; 6. Review the cart.
Expected Result: Quantity changes to 2; line total and cart subtotal are recalculated correctly; removal deletes the item; cart count updates and the empty-cart state is displayed.

Test Scenario: Prevent checkout progression with missing required data
Precondition: Start with an empty cart; an in-stock product is available; checkout is accessible without login.
Test Data: One in-stock product; required checkout fields intentionally left blank.
Test Steps: 1. Add the product to the cart; 2. Open the cart and proceed to checkout; 3. Leave required fields empty; 4. Attempt to continue or confirm checkout; 5. Review validation and checkout state.
Expected Result: Required fields are identified with validation feedback; checkout does not complete; the user remains in the checkout flow; no success confirmation or invoice is generated.

Test Scenario: Complete guest checkout and generate an invoice by pressing Confirm twice
Precondition: Start with an empty cart; an in-stock product is available; guest checkout is enabled; creation of one persistent test invoice is authorized.
Test Data: One in-stock product; valid non-sensitive guest contact and address data; assessor-approved payment option; corresponding test values supplied by approved application documentation where required.
Test Steps: 1. Add the product to the cart; 2. Proceed to checkout without logging in; 3. Enter valid guest checkout data; 4. Select the approved payment option and enter approved non-sensitive test data if required; 5. Review the product, quantity, and totals; 6. Press Confirm once; 7. Verify that the required invoice-generation completion has not yet occurred; 8. Press Confirm a second time; 9. Review the generated invoice.
Expected Result: Guest checkout is accepted without authentication; the first Confirm press does not complete the required invoice generation; the second Confirm press generates the invoice; a success state and invoice identifier are displayed; invoice product, quantity, and totals match the completed checkout.
